# Blueprint v1 case fixtures

These three JSON files are preserved copies from the original Cluenite Blueprint v1.0 data fixtures (retained unchanged in Git history):

- `q01_gallery_shadow.json`
- `m01_missing_trophy.json`
- `c01_harbor_signal.json`

They are non-authoritative reference inputs, not runtime case data or a safe public projection. Keep complete answers server-side.

Production cases are the authored Q01, M01, and C01 TypeScript definitions in `packages/cases/src`, validated by the deterministic engine. See [runtime cases](../../README.md) and [reference precedence](../../../../docs/architecture.md). Keep the original fixtures unchanged.
